## Type

- [ ] Add a new mod to the pack
- [ ] Add a Resource Slime variant for a resource the pack already has the mod for
- [ ] Replace an existing mod with this one

## The Mod / Resource

- **Mod name:**
- **Mod version (current MC 1.21.1 release):**
- **Link (CurseForge / GitHub):**
- **License:** <!-- needs to allow redistribution in a modpack -->
- **Specific resource (for variant requests):**

## Why It Fits

<!-- The pack is intentionally curated. See docs/mod_list.md for the selection
     criteria. Suggestions are evaluated against:
       (a) does this supply a tier of resources frogs farm?
       (b) does this provide automation/logistics for the post-bootstrap economy?
       (c) does this round out skyblock fundamentals?
     Pitches that don't match one of those usually get declined. -->

## Tier / Category

<!-- Which Productive Frogs category does this resource map to?
     Bog / Cave / Geode / Tide / Infernal / Void.
     If multiple, which is the primary? -->

## What Quests Would Use It

<!-- If accepted, where in the questbook does this content land? Cite a chapter
     from docs/quest_book.md or propose a new one. -->

## Alternatives Already in the Pack

<!-- Does an existing pack mod already cover this? If so, why is the new mod
     better for this specific role? Avoid pure overlap. -->

## Maintenance Cost

<!-- Each added mod is a maintenance and load-time tax. Be honest about:
       - How frequently does this mod update?
       - Does it have a track record of breaking changes between MC versions?
       - Does it depend on other mods we'd also need to ship? -->

## Additional Context

<!-- Screenshots, video, or "I ran a 2-hour test with this added on top and it
     played well" notes are all welcome. -->
